description: This file defines React hooks and a utility function for progressive batch processing, allowing UI updates to be spread over multiple idle periods or time slices. It includes a non-React controller for managing batch processing and a React hook wrapper for UI state management.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object that manages progressive batch processing, with start and cancel capabilities, and progress tracking.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: A React hook that wraps the controller, providing UI state management (running, progress, counts) and functions to start processing from a set of items or cancel ongoing processing.

ctags.signature: ({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
